operations.name: mz_stream_roundtrip
operations.summary: Exercises the zlib-style streaming API by deflating the input in chunks, then inflating the produced stream back to bytes and verifying the round-trip with checksums and sizes. This is the main hot-path workload for large realistic inputs.
operations.input_format: Raw uncompressed payload bytes. The runner treats the whole file as the source buffer and processes it via chunked streaming deflate/inflate.
operations.digest: Folds the input length, compressed length, decompressed length, deflate/inflate return codes, Adler-32 and CRC-32 of both original and recovered bytes, plus a bytewise checksum of the recovered buffer.

operations.name: tinfl_decode_blob
operations.summary: Consumes a valid compressed blob and drives the low-level tinfl decompressor through heap, mem-to-mem, and callback-style decode paths, comparing decoded content-derived checksums. Inputs are pre-generated by the library's own forward compressor.
operations.input_format: A valid zlib/deflate-compressed byte stream generated during seed creation from realistic plaintext using the library's own compressor.
operations.digest: Folds decode success/error codes, consumed compressed size, output sizes from each decode variant, CRC-32/Adler-32 of decoded bytes, callback byte count, and agreement between the independently decoded outputs.

operations.name: zip_reader_blob
operations.summary: Consumes a complete valid ZIP archive byte blob and drives reader-only functionality: initialization from memory, archive validation, file lookup, metadata queries, heap extraction, and iterative extraction. Inputs are synthesized with the library's own ZIP writer.
operations.input_format: A complete ZIP archive generated during seed creation, containing multiple deterministic files with realistic text/binary content.
operations.digest: Folds init/validation/error codes, archive size metadata, file count, located file indices, extracted byte counts from direct and iterator APIs, filename lengths, selected stat fields, and CRC-32 of extracted contents.

seed_strategy: For raw-payload operations (`mz_stream_roundtrip`, `zip_mem_roundtrip`), write two distinct deterministic realistic buffers per op: one text-heavy corpus made from repeated log/JSON/CSV-like records with moderate redundancy, and one mixed corpus combining structured text blocks plus binary-looking repeated headers/chunks. For `tinfl_decode_blob`, first synthesize those same two realistic payloads, then compress each with the library (`tdefl_compress_mem_to_heap` or `mz_compress2`) and save the resulting valid compressed blobs as the seeds. For `zip_reader_blob`, build two distinct valid ZIP archives with the library's own writer API, each containing multiple named members with different contents, comments, and sizes; save the finalized archive bytes as the seeds. All files are generated deterministically from fixed templates so `<op>.1.bin` and `<op>.2.bin` are distinct yet always identical across runs.
